quotes.text: Lead with the answer. Don't walk me through the process that you walked through to get to the answer. Give me the answer and then walk me through the process.
You do not get to decide when your audience stops listening and stops paying attention to you. They do. You have to earn the right to give the details.
There's no one single person in your career that's ever going to see all of the work that you do. But many, many people will see you talk about the work that you do.
